summary: The Metals Royalty Company Inc. (TMCR) filed a Form 6-K disclosing a fully allocated US$165 million financing to fund its acquisition of an additional 1.0% index-priced gross overriding production royalty with a revenue floor in the Mesabi Metallics iron ore project from Ironclad Royalties LLC. The package comprises US$140 million of 8% senior secured convertible notes (initial conversion price ~US$8.66, 37.5% premium to US$6.30 reference) and a US$25 million senior secured term loan (Term SOFR + 4%, 24-month maturity plus 500,000 warrants at 37.5% premium). Proceeds also repay existing debt. Share consideration to Ironclad increased to US$27.5 million. Closing concurrent on August 24, 2026. Watch for successful closing and royalty cash-flow impact; risk-arb focused on financing and acquisition completion.
